title: gfilho.net — Analytics & Security
description: Visitor traffic from the nginx access log: sources, status codes, errors, top pages, 404s, referrers, clients and unusual requests

panels.title: Visitor traffic
panels.description: Totals for the selected range, from the production access log, without the monitoring probes, automated tools and local previews (see Request sources). Requests count every response (pages, files, errors); Page views only pages answered 200 or 304. Data served = response bodies of all visitor requests (headers excluded). These are requests, not people: unique visitors cannot be counted reliably (and are not tracked). Log pipeline = probe lines received by Loki in the last 5 minutes; when it says NO LOGS the zeros here mean nothing.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"200|304" | page =~ `^/(cases/[a-z0-9-]+/)?$` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Request sources
panels.description: Every line of both access logs in exactly one group (stacked), as requests per hour: visitors, monitoring probes, automated tools (curl, scripts, headless browsers, link checkers), local previews and staging. Dashed: the total nginx counted (stub_status), which also includes the exporter's own status requests. Only "Visitors" feeds the figures on this dashboard.

targets.expr: sum by (source) (rate({job="nginx", log="access"} | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | label_format source=`{{ if eq .env "staging" }}Staging{{ else if contains "gfilho-monitor" .agent }}Monitoring probes{{ else if gt (__line__ | count "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit") 0 }}Automated tools{{ else if gt (count "^https?://(localhost|127[.]0[.]0[.]1)([:/].*)?$" .referer) 0 }}Local previews{{ else }}Visitors{{ end }}` [$__auto])) * 3600
rate(nginx_http_requests_total[$__rate_interval]) * 3600

panels.title: Visitor responses by status class
panels.description: Visitor requests per hour by HTTP status class (15-minute buckets). 4xx spikes are usually bots probing for files that do not exist (see Top 404s).

targets.expr: sum by (class) (rate({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | label_format class=`{{ substr 0 1 .status }}xx` [$__auto])) * 3600

panels.title: Error share
panels.description: Share of visitor requests in the previous hour that ended in 404, another 4xx or a 5xx (rolling 1-hour window). A static site should never answer 5xx; 404s are mostly scanners.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"4..|5.." | label_format kind=`{{ if eq .status "404" }}404 not found{{ else if hasPrefix "5" .status }}5xx server error{{ else }}Other 4xx{{ end }}` [1h])) / ignoring(kind) group_left sum(count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` [1h]))

panels.title: Data served
panels.description: Response-body bytes per second sent to visitors: pages, files and error pages (headers excluded), 15-minute buckets. Same scope as Requests, so it is not limited to page views.

targets.expr: sum(rate({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | unwrap bytes | __error__="" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Top pages
panels.description: The 10 most requested paths answered 200 or 304, without CSS, JS, images and technical files (query strings removed).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (page) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"200|304" | page !~ `^/(assets|cdn-cgi)/.*` | page !~ `.*\.(png|ico|svg|xml|txt|webmanifest|jpg|woff2|js|css|map)$` [$__range])))

panels.title: Top 404s
panels.description: Requested paths that do not exist (query strings removed). Mostly bots looking for WordPress, .env files and similar: harmless here, none of it exists.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (page) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" |= "\" 404 " | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status="404" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top referrers
panels.description: Where page views came from (links from the site itself are left out).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (referer) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"200|304" | page =~ `^/(cases/[a-z0-9-]+/)?$` | referer != "-" | referer !~ `https?://(www\.)?gfilho\.net.*` [$__range])))

panels.title: Clients
panels.description: Page views by client type, a heuristic on the User-Agent with three exclusive groups. Bots & tools: declared bots, crawlers, scanners, link previews, HTTP libraries and any User-Agent with a URL in it. Browsers: looks like a real browser (scanners can fake this, so it is an upper bound for people). Unclassified: anything else.

targets.expr: sum by (client) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"200|304" | page =~ `^/(cases/[a-z0-9-]+/)?$` | label_format client=`{{ if gt (count "(?i)(bot|crawl|spider|slurp|scan|preview|feed|monitor|checker|validator|measurement|dataprovider|heritrix|archiver|python|go-http|wget|curl|okhttp|java/|libwww|httpx|aiohttp|axios|node-fetch|undici|^node$|headless|phantom|https?://)" .agent) 0 }}Bots & tools{{ else if gt (count "^Mozilla/5[.]0 [(](Windows|Macintosh|X11|Linux|iPhone|iPad|Android)[^)]*[)].*(Chrome|Firefox|Safari|Edg|OPR)/[0-9]" .agent) 0 }}Browsers{{ else }}Unclassified{{ end }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Status mix
panels.description: All visitor requests in the selected range by status class (same colours as above).

targets.expr: sum by (class) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | label_format class=`{{ substr 0 1 .status }}xx` [$__range]))

panels.title: Unusual requests
panels.description: Visitor requests worth a look: methods other than GET and HEAD, 5xx, and 4xx other than 404 (404s are in Top 404s). The path is shown exactly as requested, query string included. Open "Logs → Unusual requests · raw lines" for the full lines.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (method, status, path) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | (status=~"4.." and status!="404") or status=~"5.." or method!~"GET|HEAD" [$__range])))

panels.title: Recent visitor requests
panels.description: Latest visitor requests to production, without monitoring probes and automated tools.

targets.expr: {job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit"

panels.title: Unusual requests · raw lines
panels.description: The full access-log lines behind "Unusual requests".

targets.expr: {job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | (status=~"4.." and status!="404") or status=~"5.." or method!~"GET|HEAD"
